item.subject: science
item.stem:
Multiple choice question: Meena plants three similar saplings in three pots at her home in Jaipur. Pot A is kept in sunlight and watered every day. Pot B is kept in sunlight but is not watered. Pot C is watered every day but kept in a dark room. After two weeks, which result should Meena expect ( )
A. Pot B grows best because sunlight alone is enough
B. Pot C grows best because watering alone is enough
C. Pot A grows best because it gets both sunlight and adequate water
D. All three pots grow equally well

options.A: Pot B grows best because sunlight alone is enough
options.B: Pot C grows best because watering alone is enough
options.C: Pot A grows best because it gets both sunlight and adequate water
options.D: All three pots grow equally well
